ability.academy.electromaster.arc_gen.de: Arouse a weak electrical arc, which causes slight damage on the area it hits. If it directly hits a flammable block, it will have a chance to ignite it.
ability.academy.electromaster.body_inten: Fine-tune your bioelectricity to improve your physical ability for a short duration.
ability.academy.electromaster.charging.d: Generate electric current to charge the thing in your hand or electric blocks in the world.
ability.academy.electromaster.mag_gravit: A deeper mastery of electromagnetism. Aim at a block and hold to charge — you will be pulled onto it, then your gravity reorients.
Manipulate and move magnetizable things with the magnetic force, even throw them out to damage enemies.
ability.academy.electromaster.mag_moveme: Manipulate magnetic fields to create electromagnetic interference with a target or location.
ability.academy.electromaster.mine_detec: Close your eyes and feel the flow of magnetism, allowing you to see a hint of precious mineral resources around you.
ability.academy.electromaster.name: Electromaster
ability.academy.teleporter.name: Teleporter
ability.academy.teleporter.threatening_t: Teleport items to somewhere around you. Sometimes just a small fragment is able to kill an enemy.
ability.academy.teleporter.penetrate_tel: Derive the thickness of an obstacle in front of you, and teleport straight through it.
ability.academy.teleporter.location_tele: Memorize your current location and teleport back from anywhere far away afterwards.
ability.academy.teleporter.mark_teleport: Marks where you are looking at as the destination, and teleports you there. Long range, but cannot pass through obstacles.
ability.academy.teleporter.dim_folding_t: Boost your damage against enemies by generating a tiny space folding phonemonon.
ability.academy.teleporter.space_fluct.d: Strengthen your space-folding ability to cause more dangerous critical damage.
ability.academy.teleporter.flashing.name: Flashing
ability.academy.teleporter.flashing.desc: A teleport far more mobile than Mark Teleport. Extreme teleport speed and momentum reset let you maneuver freely in mid-air.
ability.academy.teleporter.shift_tp.name: Shift Teleport
ability.academy.teleporter.shift_tp.desc: Launch blocks at high speed via coordinate shifting. Fire the block in your hand towards the crosshair, or with empty hands, lock onto a placed block and launch it at your target on the next cast. Entities in the path take damage; the block is placed where it lands.
gui.academy.loctele.err_exp: Exp too low, can't cross dimension
gui.academy.shift.err_protect: Skill block destruction is disabled in settings, cannot lock/extract world blocks
gui.academy.shift.err_range: Target block is out of lock range
gui.academy.shift.err_structure: Cannot lock an incomplete or special multi-block structure
gui.academy.shift.err_no_room: No open air around the target for the needles
ability.academy.meltdowner.name: Meltdowner
ability.academy.meltdowner.electron_bomb: Pull together a small amount of electrons to generate a threatening beam. After the first shot you may keep firing for 2.5 seconds, but each extra shot raises the CP cost of the next by 15%; a 1-second cooldown follows.
gui.academy.electron_bomb.no_cp: Not enough CP to gather the electrons
ability.academy.meltdowner.rad_intensify: Because of the high-intensity radiation, the target hit by beam is doubly vulnerable to attacks for a few seconds.
Forms electrons into a shield. High-speed moving electrons will destroy anything that attacks you, and damage anything touching you closely. Only blocks attacks from the front; the longer it is held, the longer the cooldown, and you are briefly slowed afterwards.
Manipulate more than one electronics group to attack. Hold to charge and manipulate more electron groups.
gui.academy.scatter_bomb.no_cp: Not enough calculation power - %s orb(s) never fired
ability.academy.meltdowner.meltdowner.de: A special electron line released with the force of a lightning strike. It scatters metal like confetti, dissolves thick walls, and punches straight through obstacles and enemies alike. Because the power is so great and unstable, a high-output meltdowner may hurt you as well. Hold to charge - the longer you charge the stronger it hits, and the longer the cooldown; release too early and it dissipates.
gui.academy.meltdowner.too_short: The electrons aren't packed yet, hold a bit longer
gui.academy.meltdowner.no_cp: Out of calculation power - the electron line dissipated
ability.academy.meltdowner.ray_barrage.d: You can conjure several electron bombs from your palm, but they cannot form a barrage, leaving you weak against saturation attacks from every direction - so you use a Silicon Barn to make up for it. Once learned, ANY of your meltdowner beams that strikes a thrown Silicon Barn bursts there into a spray of rays, sweeping onward along the beam's original heading.
ability.academy.meltdowner.jet_engine.de: Use the propulsive force of electrons to launch yourself into the air. Will generate a light-shield to protect yourself in the flight. Hold to charge - the landing marker reaches further the longer you hold; release to dash. Anything you slam into takes a hit, and a wall stops you in front of it.

gui.academy.config.push.noperm: Operator permission is required to change the server's config; your changes here only affect your own copy.

gui.academy.jet_engine.no_cp: Not enough calculation power to fire the jet
gui.academy.iron_sand.no_cp: Not enough calculation power — the sand scatters
gui.academy.jet_engine.too_short: The jet isn't primed yet, hold a bit longer
gui.academy.jet_engine.no_space: No room ahead to dash into
ability.academy.meltdowner.electron_miss: Hold together a HUGE amount of electrons in a cloud and fire only a small part of it each time. While active it locks onto nearby targets and fires on its own, and any Silicon Barn in your pack is flung the same way. You can switch between Instakill and Annihilation - Instakill locks onto hostiles only, Annihilation spares nothing.
ability.academy.vecmanip.name: Vector Manip
ability.academy.vecmanip.dir_shock.name: Directed Shock
ability.academy.vecmanip.dir_shock.desc: Seize the counterforce when punched into object and redirect it onto the object itself, making the punch more powerful.
gui.academy.dir_shock.too_short: Not charged enough, hold a bit longer
gui.academy.dir_shock.too_long: Held too long, the force dissipated
ability.academy.vecmanip.ground_shock.de: Stomp the ground and channel the reaction force forwards, bursting anything it touches into the air.
gui.academy.ground_shock.too_short: Not stomped hard enough, hold a bit longer
gui.academy.ground_shock.not_grounded: Both feet off the ground, no shockwave
ability.academy.vecmanip.vec_deviation.d: Manipulate the force and angle of whatever comes at you so that it cannot harm you, sending the damage back at the attacker or flicking the incoming object aside on the spot.
gui.academy.light_shield.no_cp: Not enough calculation power, the shield let that one through
gui.academy.vec_deviation.no_cp: Not enough calculation power, that one got through
gui.academy.dual_wing.enter: Dual Wings unfurled - skill preset suspended, middle-click to switch wings
gui.academy.dual_wing.no_target: No valid target under the crosshair
gui.academy.dual_wing.no_cp: Not enough CP to sustain the field
gui.academy.dual_wing.guard_no_cp: Not enough CP - the guard field could not absorb that hit
ability.academy.vecmanip.storm_wing.name: Storm Wing
ability.academy.vecmanip.storm_wing.desc: Manipulate the velocity of air to form four micro-whirlwinds at your back, and fly in high speed using forces they generate. Will break blocks nearby if inexperienced.
ability.academy.vecmanip.plasma_cannon.d: Manipulate a large area of air flow with extreme precision to form a plasma body. Throw it out to cause a disastrous explosion. Keep holding after it forms to amplify it - up to three times the damage, range and throwing speed, and the body swells and rises to match, at the cost of a steady CP drain.
ability.academy.vecmanip.dual_wing.name: Dual Wings
ability.academy.vecmanip.dual_wing.desc: A change of heart has awakened a stronger pair of wings - the black one for pure slaughter, the white one for protection. While active your default skill preset is suspended and replaced by the black wing's skills; middle-click to switch to the white wing's.
ability.academy.vecmanip.absolute_abilit: The pinnacle of Vector Manipulation. (Not yet available)
ability.academy.vecmanip.abyss_stride.de: Step beyond the human form and stand level with the gods. Computation power is multiplied 15x; all damage you deal becomes Vector Interference, ignoring health locks, and any target below 1 health is killed absolutely. The Dual Wings' passive takes over protected entities, granting complete immunity to death and to every status effect.
gui.academy.plasma_cannon.ready: Plasma body ready x%s - hold to amplify, release to throw
gui.academy.plasma_cannon.ready_max: Plasma body at maximum x%s - release to throw
gui.academy.plasma_cannon.too_short: The plasma body hasn't formed yet
gui.academy.plasma_cannon.no_cp: Out of CP - the plasma body collapsed
ability.academy.vecmanip.vec_accel.name: Vector Acceleration
ability.academy.vecmanip.vec_accel.desc: Redirect every bit of force from your footing straight forwards, launching yourself at tremendous speed.
ability.academy.vecmanip.dir_blast.name: Directed Blastwave
ability.academy.vecmanip.dir_blast.desc: Seize the counterforce of your punch and redirect it forwards twofold, making the fist devastating. Striking blocks directly shatters them.
ability.academy.electromaster.railgun.de: Shoot the coin out at a high speed with electromagnetic induction. Cause destructive damage where it impacts.
ability.academy.electromaster.thunder_bo: Compresses an enormous amount of electricity into a powerful bolt, bursting out and damaging anything in it's area.
ability.academy.electromaster.thunder_cl: Manipulate the magnetic field in the atmosphere to create thunderclouds, and guide the electricity down to cause a devastating strike of lightning.
Separate and manipulate the iron sand around you to create both offensive and defensive techniques.
ability.academy.generic.brain_course.des: Undergo training for your brain. Increases Max CP by 1000.
ability.academy.generic.brain_course_adv: Develop the thinking ability of your brain deeply. Increases Max CP by 1000 and Max Overload by 100.
ability.academy.generic.mind_course.desc: Learn how to relax your brain better. Speed up CP recovery by 20%.
ability.academy.generic.mind_course.name: Mind Course
ability.academy.generic.mind_calc_course: While using skills, CP spent per second will not exceed 5% of your maximum CP.
ability.academy.generic.esper_cultivatio: CP recovery rate is further increased by 100%. Upon reaching Lv5: while CP is ample, your damage additionally carries 0.1% of your current CP. While CP is scarce, this instead becomes +300% CP recovery rate and an extra 8% of max CP restored every 0.5 seconds.
ability.academy.mentalout.name: Mental Out
ability.academy.mentalout.impression.des: Distort a creature's perception of you: a hostile target turns friendly, a friendly one turns hostile. Lasts for a while.
ability.academy.mentalout.pain_numb.name: Pain Numbness
ability.academy.mentalout.pain_numb.desc: Reduces any damage you take by 99.99%
ability.academy.mentalout.daze.name: Daze
ability.academy.mentalout.daze.desc: Rob a target of any sense of time passing for a while.
ability.academy.mentalout.self_loss.name: Self Loss
ability.academy.mentalout.self_loss.desc: Robs the target of all control over itself
ability.academy.mentalout.faint.name: Asphyxiation
ability.academy.mentalout.faint.desc: Stop a target from breathing for a while, dealing continuous suffocation damage while it is unable to control itself.
ability.academy.mentalout.brain_pressure: Manipulates the target's cerebrospinal fluid, forcing secretion either up or down.
ability.academy.mentalout.forced_control: Seize partial control of a target's body and issue it various orders - though an order will sometimes fail to take.
ability.academy.mentalout.free_manip.des: See the live view of your own through the remote, or possess one of them and move it as smoothly as your own body — but none of your own abilities can be used while doing so.
ability.academy.mentalout.mind_manip.des: Take full command of a target's body - every order you give is obeyed without fail.
ability.academy.mentalout.mental_mastery: Issue multiple commands to any creature through the Remote Control.
ability.academy.mentalout.wide_cast.name: Wide-Area Broadcast
ability.academy.mentalout.wide_cast.desc: Every active skill can be issued through the Remote Control to all creatures over a wide area.
ability.academy.mentalout.absolute_abili: The pinnacle of Mental Out. (Not yet available)
